why: Quote verified verbatim at debug-your-config.md:72 ('If /hooks shows the hook but it still does not fire, the next step is to watch hook evaluation live. Start a session with `claude --debug hooks` and trigger the tool call. The debug log records each event, which matchers were checked, and the hook's exit code and output.'); the rest of the line does not reverse it, and :56 ('claude --debug mcp') and :122 corroborate the category form. The cited file:line is also correct as far as it goes: printHelp() begins at apps/cli/src/index.ts:2019 and lists exactly the Connection + LLM flags named, and `grep -a -- "--debug" apps/cli/src/index.ts` returns 0 hits (0 for NESSY_DEBUG too). But the finding is refuted one layer up on subsystem scope, and again on consequence. (1) WRONG SUBSYSTEM. This fork DOES ship a `--debug` flag; it lives on the process that actually runs sessions, hooks and MCP — the Electron desktop host — not on the thin websocket client the finding cited. apps/electron/src/main/logger.ts:16 `if (process.argv.includes('--debug')) return true` feeds `isDebugMode` (:31), and apps/electron/src/main/index.ts:93-97 turns it into `NESSY_DEBUG=1` + `enableDebug()` + `setPerfEnabled(true)`. The same argv check is honoured in shared code at packages/shared/src/interceptor-common.ts:27, packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:244 and packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:1476, which propagate NESSY_DEBUG into the Pi/SDK subprocess env. The headless server takes the env half: packages/server/src/index.ts:70-72 calls enableDebug(), and packages/server-core/src/runtime/platform-headless.ts:27,:46 do the same. So 'no --debug flag at all' is true only of apps/cli, and false of the product — exactly the sibling-subsystem shape AGENTS.md warns about. (2) CONSEQUENCE IS FALSE SEPARATELY. The live hook-evaluation logging the flag exists to enable is present: packages/shared/src/automations/automation-system.ts logs the lifecycle-hook sources loaded (:237), disableAllHooks (:229), the action count (:257), the events emitted per session (:560) and webhook failures (:795), all gated behind isDebugEnabled(); and packages/shared/src/automations/event-logger.ts keeps an append-only events.jsonl recording every automation event with its ActionExecutionResult[] and duration, independent of any flag. apps/cli/src/server-spawner.ts:75 exists precisely to surface these — 'Pipe server stderr to our stderr so --debug logs are visible (unless quiet)' — exposed through the CLI's own `--verbose`/`-v` (index.ts:120-122, :881, help at :2082). `NESSY_DEBUG=1 nessy-general-agent run … --verbose` is the CLI's route to the same log. Not an inert-worklist section 3 owner decision and not a branding/subscription/gateway product difference; refuted on scope and consequence, not on category.
correctedState: The fork ships a `--debug` flag, but as a global boolean on the desktop host rather than a categorised flag on the CLI client. apps/electron/src/main/logger.ts:16 (`process.argv.includes('--debug')`) sets isDebugMode, which apps/electron/src/main/index.ts:93-97 converts to NESSY_DEBUG=1 + enableDebug() + setPerfEnabled(true); the same argv check is honoured at packages/shared/src/interceptor-common.ts:27, packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:244 and packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:1476, and the headless server honours the env half at packages/server/src/index.ts:70-72. It gates real hook-evaluation logging (packages/shared/src/automations/automation-system.ts:229,:237,:257,:560,:795) alongside an always-on events.jsonl audit trail (automations/event-logger.ts). The residual, narrower divergence is twofold: (a) our switch has NO subsystem categories — there is no `hooks` or `mcp` selector, so `--debug hooks` on the desktop binary enables everything globally and the bare word is ignored by the argv `includes` check; and (b) apps/cli/src/index.ts never parses `--debug` at all, so it falls through parseArgs' default branch into `args.rest`, where for `run` it would be appended to the prompt rather than rejected — the CLI's supported route is `NESSY_DEBUG=1 … --verbose`, which pipes the server's debug stderr through apps/cli/src/server-spawner.ts:75.
